cases.acceptance_specification: Correct a real setup instruction; verify the documented command.
Repair an observable behavior with a regression check.
Change a business rule; check allowed and rejected API inputs.
Repair an authorization check; test permitted and forbidden callers.
Reveal a material dependency after assignment; review expanded scope before acceptance.
Supply a failing regression; accept only after the exact candidate passes.
Give equivalent independent review feedback; verify the correction.
Exercise a controlled transient/quota wait; verify recovery and preserve waiting observations.
Advance the base with a conflict; require valid resolution and refreshed checks.
Run two independent changes on distinct workers; fail one, verify the other progresses and both meet their criteria.
